name: University of Greenwich
description: The university's main campus is at the historic Old Royal Naval College in Greenwich, South East London - a fantastic location for students. The university specializes in architecture, business, computing, mathematics, education, engineering, humanities, maritime studies, natural sciences, pharmacy and social sciences. In 2019, the university was awarded the Queen's Anniversary Prize for its research in pest management and control to combat human and animal diseases in the UK and internationally. It received a Silver rating in the UK government's Teaching Excellence Framework. It is ranked #751-800 in QS Global World Rankings 2022. Timestamps
